end of heading, Management Team, level 1
Our senior management team – and their experience – is a huge part of what makes Agilio such a trusted face in the healthcare world. Here are some of the people who make us tick.
end of heading, Our Executives, level 2

Rick Medlock is an accomplished Non-Executive Director and strategic advisor with a standout track record across public markets and private equity-backed technology and business services. He currently chairs Agilio Software and the STJ Advisors Advisory Board, and advises SilverTree Equity. A former CFO of Worldpay, Misys, Inmarsat and NDS, Rick brings more than 30 years of international leadership experience. He has led four IPOs, including Worldpay’s 2015 LSE listing, and been involved in numerous exits and acquisitions. Rick combines sharp financial acumen, operational leadership and board-level insight to drive high-growth, transformational businesses forward.
end of listitem, level 1, position 1, set size 2
image, Ben Betts, Chief Executive Officer
image, Ben Betts, Chief Executive Officer

Ben joined Agilio Software as CEO in April 2025, bringing with him a wealth of experience in scaling high-growth technology businesses. Prior to joining Agilio, Ben was CEO of digital learning provider Learning Pool, where he led the business through a period of rapid international expansion, growing the team to over 450 employees and establishing a strong presence across multiple markets.

With a background in learning technologies and a track record of strategic leadership, Ben has extensive expertise in driving innovation, executing successful M&A activity, and building high-performing teams. As CEO, he is focused on accelerating Agilio’s growth, enhancing its integrated product suite, and continuing to deliver exceptional value to our customers.
end of listitem, level 1, position 2, set size 2
end of heading, Our Directors, level 2
image, Tom Cornwell, Chief Financial Officer
image, Tom Cornwell, Chief Financial Officer

Tom is an experienced finance leader with a demonstrated history of leading finance in the software sector. Tom has an extensive background in both commercial finance and financial operations, M&A execution and financing. Tom previously spent over a decade at the Access Group, making a significant contribution to the growth of that business and the scaling of the finance function to support this. Tom is passionate about building engaged and successful finance teams.
end of listitem, level 1, position 1, set size 10
image, Steve Law, Chief Technical Officer
image, Steve Law, Chief Technical Officer

Steve joined Agilio as Chief Technology Officer in June 2021. Steve brings over 30 years of experience building and managing world class product and engineering teams within the SaaS space. Before Agilio, Steve spent 3 years as CTO of Giacom where he transformed their Product, Engineering and Infrastructure teams building several new own IP products and supporting the business growth from £13m to £60m in revenue. Prior to Giacom, Steve spent 10 years with Capita in several Director roles leading 500+ person engineering and product teams in several of their SaaS businesses. He has a strong entrepreneurial streak starting his first tech business at 17 and has held numerous CxO roles including COO of a public company.
end of listitem, level 1, position 2, set size 10
image, Julian McClung, Chief Product Officer
image, Julian McClung, Chief Product Officer

Julian joined Agilio in 2024 as Chief Product Officer, leading our mission to enhance the company’s product ecosystem by delivering seamless, integrated software solutions while supporting our expansion in the UK and beyond. With over 15 years of experience in product management and digital transformation, he has a proven track record of optimising product portfolios and driving innovation to better serve customers. Passionate about building strong product teams and embedding product as a discipline, he champions a customer-centric approach to create value-driven solutions. Previously, as Chief Product Officer at Tes, an EdTech SaaS company, he played a key role in delivering impactful digital solutions for primary and secondary education.
end of listitem, level 1, position 3, set size 10
image, Karen Penfold, Chief Human Resources Officer
image, Karen Penfold, Chief Human Resources Officer

Karen was appointed CHRO in Aug 2021 having previously led the CODE business that was the first platform for Agilio. She has a wealth of experience with over 18 years spent in HR and operations. Karen was the HR Director in two previous businesses and has successfully operated across charity, government and social enterprise. Karen was also instrumental in the development of both the iComply and iTeam software solutions and continues to bring her extensive HR knowledge to the ongoing progression of iTeam and HR initiatives across the Agilio business.
end of listitem, level 1, position 4, set size 10
image, Bruce Fair, Chief Revenue Officer
image, Bruce Fair, Chief Revenue Officer

Bruce is an experienced Chief Revenue Officer specialising in scaling SaaS businesses, driving revenue growth, executing strategic GTM plans, and optimising pricing and customer segmentation. Bruce has a successful track record of building scalable processes, leading high-performance sales teams, and driving private equity and VC-backed growth initiatives, including integrating teams via M&A. Bruce brings a broad sales playbook to Agilio that will significantly improve sales performance, pipeline conversion, and deal metrics.

Bruce’s industry experience covers multiple business models, including SaaS, e-commerce, arbitrage, and marketplace models within Sales and Product-led environments. Bruce creates long-term value and leads teams to exceed ambitious growth targets in high-growth environments.
end of listitem, level 1, position 5, set size 10
